notes.title: NEW INTERACTIVE FILM 'DEVIL TIMES FIVE'
notes.content:
DEVIL TIMES FIVE (1974)

 Susan loves fire
 Moe loves to play
 Brian acts like a soldier
 David wants to be famous
 Hannah is an albino nun in training

What do they all have in common ? They are psychotic killers !
